steps.en: Install PyTorch, then the package; model checkpoints download on first run
steps.zh: 装好 PyTorch 再装包，模型权重首次运行时自动下载

steps.en: Open the GUI and drag a box around an equation on screen
steps.zh: 打开 GUI，在屏幕上框选一个公式

steps.en: A small network picks the best resolution and resizes the crop to look like training data
steps.zh: 一个小网络估出最合适的分辨率，把截图缩放成接近训练数据的样子

steps.en: The image encoder reads the crop; the decoder writes LaTeX one token at a time
steps.zh: 图像编码器读截图，解码器逐个 token 写出 LaTeX

steps.en: Renders the result with MathJax and copies the LaTeX to your clipboard
steps.zh: 用 MathJax 渲染结果，并把 LaTeX 复制到剪贴板

steps.en: Compare the preview with the original, then paste it into your document
steps.zh: 对照预览和原图核一遍，粘进你的文档

value.en: Equations become compilable LaTeX without retyping, and the image never leaves your machine
value.zh: 公式变成可编译的 LaTeX，不用手敲，图片也不出本机

sources: https://github.com/lukas-blecher/LaTeX-OCR#using-the-model (pip install "pix2tex[gui]", checkpoints downloaded automatically, latexocr GUI, MathJax render + clipboard, resolution-predicting preprocessing network, 'Always double check the result')
https://github.com/lukas-blecher/LaTeX-OCR#model (ViT encoder with ResNet backbone + Transformer decoder)
